text:
Jules: posting a short follow-up from today's all-hands re: headcount and org changes. Short TL;DR: no company-wide hiring freeze; new external reqs >L4 need a one-paragraph business case and Finance sign-off. Priorities: infra, SRE, product-security, and any roles tied to committed enterprise deals.

Ben: quick question 10: if a req is mid-interview (onsite/loop scheduled), do we pause or proceed?

People Ops: If the req maps to Priority=1 keep interviews running. For others, pause external sourcing but honor internal candidates and any already-accepted offers. Tag paused reqs in Greenhouse as `hold_external`.

Hiring Manager: We have a PM candidate with an offer in hand for a non-priority role. Offer signed yesterday 10; what happens?

CTO: If an offer is already signed, we honor it. The changes affect new external postings and active sourcing only.

Jules: managers 5: please add a one-line impact note to any req you want expedited (example: "Supports Dedicated deal ID 12345 - revenue impact Q2") and set `org-pri` tag. People Ops will compile exceptions twice daily.

Talent Partner: Internal transfers: we're fast-tracking interviews. Label candidates `internal_transfer` in Greenhouse and Recruiting will reserve interview slots. We encourage shadowing for up to 4 weeks to enable smooth moves.

Hiring Manager: Contractor conversion 1: we have a contractor critical to infra on-call 1; what's the process?

People Ops: Conversions reviewed case-by-case. Submit the conversion form + 3-month cost delta. Conversions that lower run-rate or are mission-critical get priority. Expect 48-72h review.

Recruiting Bot: Shared doc: https://redwood.internal/headcount-2026-update (internal) snapshot=2001234400

Ben: will there be any change to leveling calibration or hiring bar?

CTO: Hiring bar stays the same. We may postpone non-urgent calibration sessions but continue to make case-by-case promotions. Ping Talent Partner for level-specific questions.

Jules: Last note 6: we're standing up a small 6-person "stability pool" to cover 4-8 week backfills for critical infra/customer work; staffed centrally from approved headcount. People Ops will post a request form for teams to request deployment.

Hiring Manager: thanks 1; please drop the FAQ and the business-case template in #all-hands-summary when live.

People Ops: Will do by EOD + office hours tomorrow 11:00 for any manager walkthroughs. DM us for urgent exceptions.
